title: 429 'Requests limit for organization exceeded' when scanning many scenarios
symptoms: Log reads start failing after a burst of about 30 calls
cause: The API rate limit is shared by the whole organization, so a tight loop of reads trips it for every client in the org.
fix: Retry 429 and 5xx with exponential backoff that honors Retry-After, and pause a few hundred milliseconds between scenarios. Report a throttled read as unchecked, not as a failing scenario.
apply: await sleep(350) between scenarios; on 429 wait Retry-After seconds, else 2^attempt seconds capped at 30, and retry up to 5 times
affected: Make API v2, Pro plan organization, August 2026
